title: A SETTINGS CHANGE KEEPS ITS PLACE
why: His report of 2026-10-03: every change in the player 2 Settings threw him back to the top of the menu. Each row click rebuilds the list and the rebuild lost the scroll, the focused button and the pad highlight. All three are kept across the rebuild now, in both windows.
now: Changing a setting no longer throws you back to the top of the menu.
